messages.subject: 0.5-17 is released
parts:
Hi all,

lavaan 0.5-17 has been released on CRAN. This update fixes quite a few
(but not all) issues (see http://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot5.html).

The plan is to have one final iteration of the 0.5 series (0.5-18), to
fix all the remaining issues.

Yves.
